item.title: Preserving Nature, Not Just Profit: The Real Lessons Behind Rooibos Earth’s Essence
item.description: Discover how Rooibos Earth’s Essence founder Trevor Strydom turned indigenous fynbos into a naturally preserved liquor range now stocked at Checkers LiquorShop across the Western Cape.

item.title: Empowering Confidence: Interview With Aurum Beauty CEO, Silindokuhle Mthimunye
item.description: Empowering Confidence: Interview With Aurum Beauty CEO, Silindokuhle Mthimunye. There are brands born from market research, and then there are brands born from meaning. Aurum Beauty belongs firmly in the latter. Led by founder and CEO Silindokuhle Mthimunye, the South African beauty and wellness brand is rooted in a deeply personal story, one that transforms loss into purpose and intention into product.

item.title: Faith and Enterprise Converge at Kingdom Builders Business Summit in Johannesburg
item.description: Faith and Enterprise Converge at Kingdom Builders Business Summit in Johannesburg. The Kingdom Builders Business Forum (KBBF) has announced plans to host a business summit in February 2026, bringing together faith-driven entrepreneurs for a half-day master class focused on sustainable growth. The summit is designed to equip participants with practical business tools while reinforcing spiritual principles that guide ethical leadership and long-term enterprise development.

item.title: Sealand Gear and the Craft of Building Purpose Into Every Product
item.description: Discover the real lessons behind Sealand Gear, founded by Mike Schlebach and Jasper Eales. Learn how a Cape Town brand turned sustainability, craftsmanship, and community into a globally respected lifestyle business.

item.title: Nokusho Essentials and the Business of Affordable Care
item.description: Explore the real lessons behind Nokusho Essentials, founded by Nhlanhla Mtwakende. Learn how a township-based fragrance brand built around care, affordability, and inclusivity is creating impact through thoughtful products and clear purpose.

item.title: Gcwalisa and the Power of Township-Born Innovation
item.description: Discover the real lessons behind Gcwalisa, the township innovation founded by Miles Kubheka. Learn how refill-based groceries and solar-powered hubs are reshaping food access, sustainability, and opportunity in South African communities.

item.title: Kasi Business Exhibition Opens Applications for Exhibitors Ahead of Daveyton Workshop
item.description: Kasi Business Exhibition Opens Applications for Exhibitors Ahead of Daveyton Workshop. Join us as an exhibitor at the upcoming Kasi Business Exhibition, which will take place during the TEA Kasi Business Workshop in Daveyton, Gauteng. The event invites startups and established small businesses to participate by showcasing, networking, and selling their products directly to attendees.

item.title: Turning Pain Into Purpose: The Quiet Power Behind Khensani Sayiya’s Literary Journey
item.description: Discover how author Khensani Sayiya transformed personal struggle into purpose through her poetry anthology I Saw It With My Naked Eye and built a meaningful literary path.

item.title: Why Mentorship is the Missing Link: Interview With Founder of Aions Ventures, Mitchan Adams
item.description: Why Mentorship is the Missing Link: Interview With Founder of Aions Ventures, Mitchan Adams. item.description: PG Bison Reinforces Sustainable Timber Manufacturing as Driver of African Industrial Growth.
